name: Slider
description: Picks a number from a range by dragging or with the arrow keys, with the value shown.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible label, connected to the input.

props.name: value
props.description: The current value, for a controlled slider.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The starting value. Defaults to min.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the new value while dragging or stepping.

props.name: min / max / step
props.description: The range and its increment. Default 0, 100 and 1.

props.name: format
props.description: Formats the shown value and its aria-valuetext.

props.name: ...props
props.description: All other native attributes of the range input.

a11y: Built on <input type="range">: arrow keys, Page Up/Down, Home and End work natively.
The label is a real <label>, the value an <output> for the input, and format() also sets aria-valuetext.
